## Details

<a id="arena2_screen"></a>
### [`arena2_screen`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_screen.asm#L6) `$E000-$E3E7`

*data*

Screen RAM of the arena that is not on screen, 40 bytes for each row. $8f8c swaps rows 7-22, columns 4-35 with $4400. Nothing reads the other bytes of $e000-$e3ff.

- **Referred to by:** [`swap_centre_colours`](../screen/scene.md#swap_centre_colours)
